comments.body: prosemirror-history config has newGroupDelay: 800 but our custom plugin also tags transactions with addToHistory and a sticky groupId. Inspecting that path next.

content.text: prosemirror-history config has newGroupDelay: 800 but our custom plugin also tags transactions with addToHistory and a sticky groupId. Inspecting that path next.

Editor undo (Cmd/Ctrl+Z) normally reverses one logical typing burst. After the user pauses longer than the idle merge window (~800ms) and types again, several distinct keystrokes from the new burst are later undone as a single step, so undo removes more text than expected.

Each continuous typing segment after an idle gap should become its own history item. The history plugin resets the merge timer on idle but reuses the same transaction group id when focus never left the doc, so the next characters join the previous closed step.
Writers who undo carefully lose whole words instead of the last character. Generating a new history group id whenever the idle timer fires would restore per-burst undo.
